title: Mixed Event — One Small Trip Before a Big Journey — Episode2 Fun Field Trip Planning

meta.Event: One Small Trip Before a Big Journey
meta.Event Outline: The Miya Girls first years are headed to Yokohama! Haruka realizes this field trip might be her last memory with her general education class before returning to the credit-based course. Saki asks to be in her group for the trip.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's see... Free time starts at 12 p.m., and we'll need to come up with enough things to do until 5 p.m.

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: With five whole hours, the world is our oyster!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we will need to meet up with the rest of the class before going home, so we probably shouldn't go overboard.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, then let's make sure we leave some leeway in our plans so we'll be in time to meet up at 5 p.m.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is there anywhere in particular you'd like to go, Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This place has all-you-can-eat meat buns... And if we go down this street, then we can also have yum cha...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, are you listening?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wha?! I-I'm totally listening!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Leave it to me! I'll whip up an ultra fun plan to fill up all the time that we have!

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line:
I knew it. You weren't listening at all.
We were just talking about how it'd be better not to do that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can understand where you're coming from, though. It's so easy to get carried away when looking at the guidebook.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe. I can't help but want to do everything when reading through these sorts of things...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And check this out!
Aren't the peach buns from this place so cute?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, they're so little and cute.
They're shaped like peaches, but they have a custard filling.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line:
And it's all-you-can-eat?!
I could probably eat so many that I'd lose count!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, right?
We should totally have an eating competition!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, sounds fun.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But if we fill up on those, it won't leave much stomach space to try other stuff, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, true...
It'd be a shame to not try a bunch of stuff while we're there.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In that case, let's look for other things outside of Chinatown. How about exploring around Minato Mirai?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's a great idea! There's a bunch of really classy spots around there! Where should we start?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, look. We can go on a tour of a ship over here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: See? They have photos too. It looks so grand...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're right! You can not only see the inside of the ship, but also enjoy a really nice view from the deck!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Oooh. I wouldn't mind going.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It looks nice! Shall we put it down in our itinerary?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, putting it down now!
We should find somewhere nearby for lunch, but what would be good...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm, good question...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Lunch nearby...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I know. How about this curry place?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Curry?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I went there once for a shoot. The place was stylish and the food was really delicious.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: For a shoot?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, sounds good.
There's a description of the place in the guidebook too.

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line:
You're right. It says...
“Enjoy the authentic flavors and enticing aromas of curry from Yokohama, its birthplace in Japan.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! Sounds amazing! I'm sure it won't be a miss, especially since Haruka recommended it. Can we have lunch here?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe, if everyone is alright with it, then I'll write it down on our itinerary.
Where should we go afterwards?

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: How about the Red Brick Center? We can get some souvenirs and stuff there!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good idea. I'm sure they have a lot of things for sale. In that case...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This is fun. Just looking through the guidebook with everyone is making me so excited...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(But it is Yokohama, though...
There's going to be a lot of people, so I should probably put on some sort of disguise.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I hope we all have a good time together.)
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Field trip itinerary?
That's right, I guess it's already that time of the year.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So where are you all going this year?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yokohama. We'll be going to the History Archive Museum for some studying, and then we'll have free time with our groups.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My group and I were talking about walking around the harbor, going on a tour of a ship and having some curry for lunch.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That sounds like so much fun! I'm sure the sea breeze would feel wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Where was the field trip when you were first-years?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We went to PXL.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah. Unfortunately, I wasn't able to go since I had work.
But more importantly, Yokohama is such a classy place to visit.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
PXL and Yokohama both sound super fun♪
Minori, since you're also a first-year, does that mean you're going too?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Me and Haruka are in different classes though, so we won't be able to go around together...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But my group and I have decided to go around Chinatown!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's supposed to be a lot of good food over there, right? What are you going to try?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see... So first things first, that famous meat bun place! And then the famous peach bun place, and then that pot sticker place...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're planning to eat all of that?!
I think I'd be too full to go on...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Don't worry! All of us want to try a bunch of stuff, so we'll be splitting everything within the group.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, smart!
It'll be much more fun getting to try a variety!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wonder what sort of food would be there...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! In that case, let's flick through the guidebook together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I actually brought it with me! Ta-da!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Look at you, all prepared.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe, I wanted to show it to Miku and everyone!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's so sweet♪ Show me, show me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, let's look at it together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Check this out, Miku!
This steamed bun is shaped like a panda!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It is!
It's called a “panda bun”. That's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And this castella looks so soft and yummy!
I wonder what it tastes like.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, then I'll get some for you as a souvenir!
We can all share!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Really? Thanks, Minori!
Looks like Yokohama is just full of delicious things to eat♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm also curious about that curry place Haruka mentioned.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I didn't know you were such a glutton, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Huh? D-Did I sound like one?
But they all sound so good...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, I understand how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then I'll also bring back some yummy souvenirs so you don't feel like you missed out, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Y-You too, Haruka?!
I would really appreciate it, though...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ah, Airi, Shizuku! We'll definitely get souvenirs for you too, so please look forward to them!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you. Then I shall be patiently waiting.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori, Haruka, you two are always working really hard, so please try to relax on your field trip as much as possible.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree! You're always putting in everything you have for your shows and work.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's a special occasion, so please enjoy your field trip as any high school students would!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As high school students...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right.
Thank you, Miku.
